summary: Iteration 3 tested the 4 new features (notifications, percent discount, cashier shift, customers + loyalty points) end-to-end. Backend: 30/30 pytest tests pass (added TestNotifications, TestCustomers, TestDiscountAndPoints, TestShifts covering CRUD, role gating, percent-discount math, points award, shift open/close reconciliation). Frontend (Playwright, admin login): notification bell shows badge with count=10 after raising threshold via Settings; dropdown lists low-stock items. Customer created via /customers page; selected in POS payment dialog. Percent discount 10% on Rp18.000 cart correctly reduced total to Rp16.200 (potongan Rp1.800) — matches backend. Receipt dialog displays customer name and 'Poin diperoleh'. Shift page: open with Rp100.000, close with Rp100.500 -> row appears in history with difference badge. Threshold restored to 10 at end.

minor.issue: Returns 400 when a shift is already open. Spec text mentioned 409 or 400; 400 is acceptable but 409 Conflict would be more semantically correct.
Any authenticated user (including cashier) can create customers. Product spec only restricts edit/delete for cashier, so this is intentional but worth confirming.
If customer_id references a non-existent Customer, the sale is still saved (customer_name=null, points_earned=0) with no 404. Consider validating.

issues: Toast 'Pengaturan toko disimpan' overlaps with dialog top area (minor).

action_items: (Optional) Return HTTP 409 instead of 400 for /api/shifts/open when a shift is already open.
(Optional) Validate customer_id existence at POST /api/sales and return 400/404 if invalid.
(Carry-over) Login.js navigate-in-render warning and DialogDescription a11y warnings from prior iteration.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py checkout(): stock aggregation by product_id is now correct (fixed vs iteration 2 feedback).
server.py checkout(): loyalty points computed as floor(total/1000) matches spec.
server.py close_shift(): correctly computes expected_cash = opening_cash + cash_sales and difference; only counts cash sales for expected.
server.py get_notifications(): reads low_stock_threshold from settings with default 10 — good.
NotificationBell.js: fetches /notifications only on mount; a badge won't refresh after new sales unless component re-mounts. Consider polling or refetch after checkout.
POS.js: customerId 'none' sentinel used to bypass empty-string SelectItem constraint — clean workaround.
POS.js: percent discount rounded via Math.round; backend receives already-computed `discount` amount (in Rp) plus discount_type/discount_value for audit — good.
Shift.js: renders active shift and history correctly, closes+reopens works. No edge case for admin viewing all shifts vs cashier viewing own — implemented in backend list_shifts.
Customers.js: edit/delete buttons hidden for cashier via isAdmin flag — matches spec.
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_UI_Cust_<ts> customer via UI; also several TEST_ prefixed customers/products from backend tests are cleaned up. Left ~3 closed shifts in history from test runs (admin owner shifts).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py now has 30 tests (added TestNotifications, TestCustomers, TestDiscountAndPoints, TestShifts). Store settings currently: 'TEST Toko Kopi', threshold restored to 10. Owner (admin) has ~3 closed shifts in history from testing.
